description: This file defines the DynamoDbStreamsClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with Amazon DynamoDb Streams service, including methods for describing streams, getting records, and listing streams, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: DynamoDbStreamsClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon DynamoDb Streams, extending AwsClient, with specific methods for stream operations and custom argument configurations.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Overrides the parent getArguments method to set default retry configurations, including the default number of retries and the retry function.
